name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the user explicitly requests the next APK update.
notes: Phase 341 keeps the uploaded FBX table as the sole table body and normalizes felt, rail, and trim materials.
One table-local coordinate model drives the south/front player seat, bots, pass line, logo, burn pile, muck, hole cards, and community cards.
Phase 341 replaces duplicate static card planes with one reusable animated card pool.
Hole cards deal left-to-right in two rounds; burns, flop, turn, river, folds, and showdown flips animate from the Phase 336 state.
Android keeps one MOVE stick and one LOOK stick and routes poker buttons directly to Phase 336.
APK update prompts remain disabled and updates remain manual-only.
